title: The Window over which Kiosk Discount is Read for a Micro Market Settlement
content:
A busy quarter at the kiosk can shorten or lengthen the window over which the client discount met is read for an Unattended Micro Market Program settlement, and whether an approved kiosk outage request stands on the agreement settles which way it moves.

## The clause

1. Where the kiosk posted at or above 10 drawdowns over the three months to the day the settlement is raised, and the agreement carries no approved kiosk outage request over the same three months, the discount met is taken over the two months to that day.
2. Where the kiosk posted at or above 10 drawdowns over those three months, and the agreement carries an approved kiosk outage request over the same three months, the discount met is taken over the six months to that day and halved, so that an interrupted quarter is smoothed against the half year around it.
3. Where neither of those holds, no such change to the window is made.

## The boundary

The busy-quarter trip count is 10 drawdowns over the three months to the day the settlement is raised. A quarter carrying exactly 10 drawdowns is at or above the count; a quarter carrying 9 is below it and reaches neither of the first two lines.

## Combinations

| Drawdowns over the three months | Approved kiosk outage request over the same three months | Judgement |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 10 or more | none | the discount met is taken over the two months to that day |
| 10 or more | at least one | the discount met is taken over the six months to that day and halved |
| 9 or fewer | none | no such change to the window is made |
| 9 or fewer | at least one | no such change to the window is made |

*Hypothetical.* An agreement posting 14 drawdowns in the quarter with no approved kiosk outage request reads the two months to the day the settlement is raised. The same agreement with one such request approved reads the six months to that day and halves what it finds: 9800.00 USD met over six months is read as 4900.00 USD.
